candidates.description: Map one caller-supplied structured public citation to the PMID reported by the fixed NCBI ECitMatch endpoint; return no article metadata or text.
candidates.license: Wrapper BUSL-1.1. NCBI E-utilities usage terms apply; the adapter emits no article text and makes no reuse-right determination. https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/home/about/policies/ and https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/About/disclaimer.html.
candidates.maintainer: Ignition repository maintainers; this field does not grant Owner or scientific authority.
good_for: Returning a provider-reported PubMed PMID for one public citation supplied as journal title, year, volume, first page, and first author.
Recording whether the provider reports no match while keeping citation and response hashes for later review.
Using a structured citation when the caller has neither a DOI nor an existing PMID and needs only an identifier candidate.
not_for: Searching arbitrary free text, retrieving article metadata, abstracts, full text, or publisher content.
Authenticating the citation, proving the returned record is bibliographically correct, or assessing relevance or scientific support.
Concluding that an article does not exist from NO_MATCH_REPORTED or a provider/network failure.
Using confidential, patient-identifying, or otherwise sensitive citation fields with a public service.
only_if: The caller supplies exactly one structured, public, non-sensitive citation and explicitly permits sending those five fields to NCBI.
The invocation separately passes --allow-public-network and permits eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov.
A DOI-to-identifier adapter or an already-known PMID is not available for the task; the candidate remains excluded unless explicitly allowlisted.
counterindicated_when: The citation fields are confidential, patient-identifying, or otherwise inappropriate to transmit to a public provider.
Network use is unavailable or has not been separately authorized for this invocation.
The task requires title/abstract/full-text review, exhaustive or free-text search, bibliographic adjudication, or scientific assessment.
accepted_input_types: UTF-8 JSON stdin object with exactly journal_title, year, volume, first_page, and first_author; public non-sensitive citation
output_types: One provider-reported PubMed PMID for the structured citation, or an explicit NO_MATCH_REPORTED observation, with citation/response hashes and bounded status
side_effects: When the caller separately permits the public lookup and passes --allow-public-network, sends exactly one HTTPS GET with the five structured citation fields and a fixed tool parameter to eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov; no email or API key is sent.

Does not follow redirects, retry, access arbitrary URLs, write files, mutate the repository, or return a title, abstract, or full text. The caller-provided citation fields may be logged by the provider outside this wrapper.
The response digest binds received bytes but not provider authenticity; no raw provider body is persisted.

estimated_cost.basis: One public request was observed for the official example; no billed cost, latency distribution, service reliability, or analyst-time comparison was measured.

findings: An earlier source version and a one-request ESearch probe reported PMID 2014248 for the official example citation; the final-source public request ended in NETWORK_ERROR.

Keep replacement_candidates empty and preserve COMPARISON_UNKNOWN; no existing adapter is retired or deprecated.
